Who made this, what it is built on, and the licence.

Credits

This mod

Rimrooms — Async Industries. Original source is supplied under MIT.

RimWorld

RimWorld and its game assemblies are supplied by Ludeon Studios and their respective owners. They are local requirements and are not bundled here.

This is a mod for RimWorld. No endorsement is implied.

Inspiration

Kane Pixels' series and the separate A24 feature inform an indirect story and style adaptation.

No film frames, footage, audio or dialogue are included. Those rights are separate from this project's source licence.

Other mods

Other mods are separately installed. None of their files are bundled or modified.

Requiring a mod does not mean its authors support or endorse this one.

Art

The main-menu backgrounds are original to this project.

No gameplay art or audio is shipped — every object in play is existing game or mod content.

Tooling

Built with Microsoft's .NET SDK. Source inspection used ILSpy.

Neither is distributed with the mod.

Rimrooms — Async Industries. A development build; nothing here is a balance, performance or compatibility report.
